title: Silent Visual Reading EEG
description: This dataset contains raw and processed EEG recordings from participants engaged in silent visual reading of word stimuli presented in naturalistic narrative contexts. The study investigates auditory representations of words during silent visual reading by recording neural activity while participants view unique and repeated story narratives. Raw data are provided in BrainVision format with comprehensive event annotations, alongside preprocessed EEG signals and corresponding feature embeddings organized at the word level.
methods_description: EEG data were collected while participants viewed word stimuli forming naturalistic narratives presented on a grey background with central fixation. Trigger codes marked word onsets in unique (S111) and repeated (S71) stories, with run onset (S71) and end (S78) markers. Raw data are provided in BrainVision format (.eeg, .vhdr, .vmrk files) organized according to BIDS specification. Preprocessed EEG signals and word-level feature embeddings are provided in the derivatives folder.
